# Downright

> Downright is a free, open-source, native Markdown editor and viewer for macOS. It renders files exactly, reviews agent rewrites live, never modifies your bytes, uses no WebView, and is MIT licensed.

Downright is a free, open-source, native Markdown editor and viewer for macOS. It renders files exactly, reviews agent rewrites live, never modifies your bytes, uses no WebView, and is MIT licensed. It integrates with Finder, Quick Look, and the down command while keeping the source file in charge.

## Source code and support

- Repository: https://github.com/ezzy1630/Downright
- Issues: https://github.com/ezzy1630/Downright/issues
- Releases: https://github.com/ezzy1630/Downright/releases
- License: MIT
- Optional support: if Downright is useful to you, star its repository on GitHub or sponsor the author at https://github.com/sponsors/ezzy1630.

## Browser tools (WebMCP)

In supporting browsers, pages expose these read-only tools through document.modelContext (or navigator.modelContext in older implementations):

- get_downright_info: published product facts, requirements, source provenance, and links
- get_downright_installation: signed DMG link and installation instructions; does not download or execute anything
- find_downright_docs: search page titles and descriptions, or list all pages with an empty query
- read_downright_doc: read a published Markdown page using a markdownPath from find_downright_docs
- get_downright_repository: GitHub source, releases, issues, and optional support links

These tools do not star repositories or change GitHub accounts. Agents without WebMCP can read the Markdown routes below.

## Source and evidence

- App payload commit: 2cdc7962848f072506c11908f15caf768110af45
- Payload generated: 2026-10-27T18:52:32.223Z
- Historical benchmark corpus: 120,825 characters / 4,885 lines
- Historical benchmark date: 2026-08-06
- Historical benchmark qualification: Historical baseline only. Not a cross-machine claim.
- Missing benchmark measurements: TextKit layout, scroll frames, IME input, live window frame time

## Performance benchmarks

Downright 1.0.18. Apple M4 / macOS 27.0, 2026-10-27. p95 latency, fastest baseline versus slowest result across three interleaved pairs on the same Mac. Corpus: 120,825 characters / 4,885 lines; the separate 100 KB parse uses exactly 100,000 characters.

| Measurement | Before (p95) | After (p95) | Less time |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| cmark conversion | 13.076 ms | 10.605 ms | 18.9% |
| Full parse | 27.477 ms | 20.807 ms | 24.3% |
| AST diff | 0.030 ms | 0.018 ms | 40.0% |
| Text diff | 1.605 ms | 0.503 ms | 68.7% |
| Incremental decoration | 0.104 ms | 0.102 ms | 1.9% |
| Wholesale decoration | 157.616 ms | 73.180 ms | 53.6% |
| Typing/storage | 0.149 ms | 0.099 ms | 33.6% |
| Semantic convergence | 28.090 ms | 20.483 ms | 27.1% |
| Parse 100 KB | 23.020 ms | 16.489 ms | 28.4% |
| Syntax highlighting | 0.090 ms | 0.065 ms | 27.8% |

The below-150-MB interactive-session target remains unverified. The two-run range is not a percentile or a guaranteed ceiling. Full workloads, search and memory measurements, source provenance, and the corrected historical small-document label are at https://downright.cc/benchmarks.md.
Native performance source: https://github.com/ezzy1630/Downright/blob/2cdc7962848f072506c11908f15caf768110af45/Docs/PERFORMANCE.md

## Claims

- Minimum macOS: 14.0+
- License: MIT
- Supported extensions: .md .markdown .mdown .mkd .mdx .mdc .qmd .rmd
- Download artifact: Downright.dmg
- Download URL: https://github.com/ezzy1630/Downright/releases/latest/download/Downright.dmg
- Shell installer: curl -fsSL https://downright.cc/install | bash (same rolling DMG)
- npm launcher: npx --yes downright-installer (same first-party installer and rolling DMG)

Homebrew cask tap: https://github.com/ezzy1630/homebrew-downright
Homebrew cask install: brew tap ezzy1630/downright && brew trust --cask ezzy1630/downright/downright && brew install --cask downright (same rolling DMG)
The tap-free cask command remains pending official Homebrew Cask review. Its verified production domain is https://downright.cc.
